deshpande2018.citation: Deshpande, Spoelstra, van Doorn, Kerssemakers and Dekker (2018), Mechanical Division of Cell-Sized Liposomes

daughter_diameters.observable: Smaller daughter diameter divided by larger daughter diameter
daughter_diameters.limits: Mechanical splitting at a microfluidic junction. These diameters do not count membrane molecules or identify a growth threshold.

deshpande2018.observable: Slope of summed daughter fluorescence against fluorescence of the corresponding parent at the microfluidic splitter
deshpande2018.conditions: DOPC-based giant liposomes crossing a Y-junction. The fit uses events with two observable daughters.
deshpande2018.limits: The corrections for channel geometry and object size approximately cancel. Optical recovery depends on signal calibration. There is no independently quantified exterior dye inventory for these pairs.

fayolle2018.citation: Fayolle, Fiore, Stano and Strazewski (2018), Rapid purification of giant lipid vesicles by microfiltration
fayolle2018.conditions: DOPC/DOPA (7:3) giant vesicles containing calcein. Each retentate has a volume of 1 mL. The lipid assay measures recovered material in that volume.
fayolle2018.limits: Five confocal micrographs per signal estimate. The later exterior signals reach the instrument floor. No lipid error bars or independent filtrate and total entrapped calcein inventories were reported.
